[size=6][color=#dbb0a7]Mr. Doggy for Content Patcher[/color]
[/size]
[i]This mod will turn your sweet K9 companion into a Mr. Handy robot (from the Fallout universe) who thinks he's a dog.[/i]

• Changes the first dog sprite to a Mr. Handy robot
• Changes the first dog icon to a Mr. Handy robot
• Changes in-game dialogue during adoption event (Marnie now says 'robot' instead of 'dog')
• Includes config file with top hat and dialogue options (run game with mod installed to generate config file)

[b]WHAT'S NEW IN 1.1.0[/b]
- Now updated for Stardew Valley 1.4.0+!
- Config file now includes option to toggle Marnie's event dialogue (default: true; set to false when selecting other pets)
- Select first dog option on character creation screen to use this mod

[b]HOW TO INSTALL
[/b]• [url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url]
• Download this mod and unzip it into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
• Run the game using SMAPI.
